failure: No retry was submitted automatically. Check that your account is deployed and recent balance changes have settled, then try again.
proving: Building the registration proof and estimating the network fee. Nothing is signed or sent until you confirm the review; going back discards this preparation.
Keep the wallet open. Proving may take longer than a normal token transfer.
success: You can now shield ETH from its asset screen.
